svg.title: Platform architecture
svg.desc: Four columns: inputs, analysis, evidence and graph, and action and output. Each block shows its maturity as text: GA, Preview, Labs or Roadmap. Live production signals and connected SIEM detection are Roadmap and not shipped; detection and response is Labs. A model egress policy gates every outbound model call.
svg.text: Deterministic evidence at the core. Agents propose and fix. Every output carries its scan health.
Model egress policy (allow, deny, local-only, redaction) gates every outbound model call. GA.
Loop: Detect / Verify / Learn feed a stronger Discover and Corroborate.
